/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json, re
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/ADOBE_2019_10K_reconstructed.json'
obj=json.load(open(p))
texts=obj['texts'] if isinstance(obj,dict) and 'texts' in obj else obj
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    txt=t.get('text','')
    if re.search(r'total assets', txt, re.I):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'TEXT',txt)
PY"
